name: Brigade Blocks Addons
author: brigadethemes

sections.description:
Brigade Blocks Addons extends the WordPress Block Editor with professionally designed blocks, without a page builder. Everything is organised into modules you can switch on or off; a disabled module registers no blocks, scripts or styles.

Every block can be styled in depth from the editor’s Styles tab — typography, colors, gradients, background images with overlays, borders, per-corner radius, layered box shadows, spacing, sizes, flex and grid layout, position, opacity and visibility — separately for hover, focus and active states and for desktop, tablet and mobile. Only the controls that make sense for each block are shown.

Blocks use the Donix design system — coral accent, ink headings, Urbanist type and a single 6px radius — and every value is a CSS custom property your theme can override.

Documentation: a guide for every block, with every setting explained — https://brigadethemes.github.io/brigade-blocks-addons/

Content module (available now)

  • Container — nestable flex or grid layout wrapper: full-width or boxed content, presets (columns, centered, horizontal), sizing, positioning, transforms, backgrounds, overlays and per-device settings; any block inside gets flex-item controls
  • Heading — eyebrow label, accent separator, supporting text
  • Text Editor — rich text with columns and drop cap
  • Image — aspect-ratio crop, hover effects, caption, link
  • Image Box — stacked or overlay image card
  • Icon — 49 line icons with tinted badge styles
  • Icon Box — feature / service card
  • Button — primary, dark, outline and text styles
  • Divider — with optional label or icon
  • Spacer — separate desktop, tablet and mobile heights
  • Video — YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted, loaded on click
  • HTML — custom markup with live preview
  • Shortcode
  • Google Maps — no API key, info card, directions link, optional click-to-load for GDPR

Interactive module

  • Accordion — native, JavaScript-free; one-at-a-time option; FAQ schema
  • Nested Accordion
  • Tabs — accessible, keyboard navigable, deep-linkable; horizontal or vertical
  • Content Toggle — switch between two panels, e.g. monthly and yearly pricing
  • Timeline — one-sided or alternating
  • Process Steps — numbered or icon steps with connectors
  • Slider — slides you design yourself with any blocks, each with its own background image, colour and overlay; slide or fade, one or several slides at a time, arrows, dots and autoplay

Marketing module

  • Flip Box — flips on hover, focus or tap
  • Call to Action — dark, brand, tinted or image background
  • Counter — animated statistic
  • Progress Bar — fills when scrolled into view

Posts module

  • Posts — one block with five layouts (grid, list, masonry, carousel, slider) and three sources (custom query, most recent, related to the current post); any public post type, category/tag filters, responsive columns
  • AJAX Load More, Infinite Scroll and AJAX category filter
  • Author Box
  • Dynamic Content — show a post field or custom field anywhere, including inside the Query Loop

Media module

  • Gallery — one block with four layouts (grid, masonry, carousel, slider), an accessible lightbox, captions, hover effects and a filter bar built from image tags
  • Before / After — compare two images with a draggable divider; horizontal or vertical, keyboard and touch friendly
  • Video Gallery — YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted videos in a grid or carousel; play in a lightbox or in place, loaded only when clicked

WooCommerce module (when WooCommerce is active)

  • Products — one block with four layouts (grid, list, carousel, slider) and nine sources: latest, featured, on sale, best selling, top rated, hand-picked, related, upsells and cross-sells; AJAX add to cart, sale badges and a second image on hover
  • Product Categories — image tiles in a grid or carousel
  • Product Search — with an optional category dropdown
  • Add to Cart — for any product or the one being viewed, with quantity
  • Mini Cart — live count and total, with an accessible slide-in cart drawer
  • Store Page — WooCommerce’s cart, checkout or My Account inside your own page layout

Forms & Users module

  • Login Form — log in, register and reset a password in one block, without reloading the page; falls back to the standard WordPress login whenever needed (no JavaScript, cached pages, two-factor plugins) and works with captcha and security plugins
  • User Profile — the visitor’s avatar, name, bio, account and log-out links
  • Form Styler — Contact Form 7 and WPForms forms in your design

Advanced module

  • Advanced Search — keyword, content type and taxonomy filters with accessible live results
  • Taxonomy Filter — categories, tags or any taxonomy as chips, a list or a dropdown, linking to their archives

Data Visualization module

  • Chart — bar, horizontal bar, line, area, pie, doughnut and radar charts from numbers you type (or paste from a spreadsheet) or from a CSV / Google Sheets link; lightweight SVG with a data table for screen readers, no chart library
  • Progress Chart — progress rings and half-circle gauges
  • Statistics Cards — key numbers that count up, with trend badges and sparklines

People module

  • Team Member — photo, name, role, bio and social links; photo above, beside or with the name over it; rectangle or round photo
  • Testimonials — quotes with name, role, photo and 1–5 star rating, in a grid or a carousel

Navigation module

  • Breadcrumbs — builds itself for every page, post, product, archive and search; BreadcrumbList structured data (can be turned off if an SEO plugin already adds it)
  • Table of Contents — lists the post’s headings and links to them, updates as you edit, nested levels, collapsible, highlights the section being read

Utilities module

  • Social Icons — 28 networks (the icons WordPress uses), brand colours or Donix styles, optional names, nothing loaded from the networks
  • WhatsApp Chat — a floating chat button with an optional greeting card, or a button in your content; nothing loads from WhatsApp until clicked

Coming next

Pricing Table, Countdown and Logo Showcase.

Brigade Blocks Addons Pro

A separate, optional add-on adds a Dynamic Data module: Loop Builder, Dynamic Tags and Conditional Content. This plugin is complete on its own and contains no Pro code; its settings screen lists Pro modules and blocks with a PRO badge so you can see what the add-on includes. Learn more: https://github.com/brigadethemes/wp-block-brigade-pro

Performance and privacy

  • Styles load only on pages that use a block.
  • Front-end scripts are tiny, dependency-free and load only with their block: click-to-load for Video and Google Maps, Tabs, Content Toggle, Counter, Progress Bar, carousels, AJAX load more / filter, live search, the login form, the mini cart drawer and chart animations. Accordion, Flip Box, post grids, lists and masonry, and every chart itself need no JavaScript.
  • The Urbanist font is served from your own site. Choose “Inherit from theme” to load no fonts at all.
  • YouTube uses youtube-nocookie.com and Vimeo uses do-not-track; neither loads until the visitor presses play.

External services

Some blocks can show content from third-party services. Nothing is sent to these services unless you add the block to a page, and the Video and Google Maps blocks can wait until the visitor clicks before loading anything.

Google Maps (Google Maps block)

The Google Maps block embeds a map from Google Maps (maps.google.com) for the address or place you enter, and can link to Google Maps directions. When the map loads, the visitor’s browser requests it from Google, which receives the visitor’s IP address, browser details and the address or place shown. With “Click to load” enabled, nothing is requested until the visitor clicks the map.

  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms and https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

YouTube (Video and Video Gallery blocks)

When a Video or Video Gallery block uses a YouTube link without a custom poster, the thumbnail is loaded from i.ytimg.com and, after the visitor presses play, the video is embedded from youtube-nocookie.com. YouTube receives the visitor’s IP address, browser details and the video ID.

  • Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Vimeo (Video and Video Gallery blocks)

When a Video or Video Gallery block uses a Vimeo link, the video is embedded from player.vimeo.com (with Do Not Track) after the visitor presses play. Vimeo receives the visitor’s IP address, browser details and the video ID.

  • Terms of Service: https://vimeo.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

Google Sheets or another CSV link (Chart block)

Only when you set a Chart block’s data to “From a link”, your website’s server downloads that link — for example a Google Sheet (docs.google.com) or any CSV file address you enter — to draw the chart, and keeps a cached copy (5 minutes to one day, as you choose). The request is made by your server, not by visitors’ browsers; it contains no visitor data, only the address you entered. Private or local network addresses are never contacted.

  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • For any other address, the terms and privacy policy of the site that hosts the file apply.

Credits

  • Urbanist font by The Urbanist Project Authors (https://github.com/coreyhu/Urbanist), licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see assets/fonts/OFL.txt). Bundled so no font is loaded from third-party servers.
  • Line icons were drawn for this plugin and are licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin, or copy it to wp-content/plugins.
  2. Activate Brigade Blocks Addons.
  3. Open Brigade Blocks in the admin menu to choose modules and blocks.
  4. In the editor, search for “Brigade” in the block inserter.
sections.faq:
Does it require a page builder?

No. It is built entirely on the native Block Editor.

What happens to my content if I disable a module?

Nothing is deleted. The blocks stop rendering and are restored as soon as you switch the module back on.

Can my theme change the colors and fonts?

Yes. Override the –wpbb-* custom properties, for example :root { –wpbb-brand: #0a7cff; }.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes, Brigade Blocks Addons Pro is a separate add-on that needs this plugin. Everything described above is free and stays free. Learn more: https://github.com/brigadethemes/wp-block-brigade-pro

Where is the source code of the compiled scripts?

The human-readable source of every file in build/ is included in the src/ folder of the plugin. Build it with Node.js: npm install then npm run build (see package.json).
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New People module: Team Member and Testimonials blocks.
  • New Navigation module: Breadcrumbs (with structured data) and Table of Contents blocks.
  • New Utilities module: Social Icons and WhatsApp Chat blocks.
  • The three new modules are switched on by default; switch any of them off under Brigade Blocks → Modules.

1.0.1

  • New: Documentation link on the Plugins screen and on the settings screen.
  • Changed: the Get Pro button now leads to the Brigade Blocks Addons Pro page.

1.0.0

  • Styling system: per-element, per-state and responsive styling controls for every block, in the native Styles tab with live editor preview.
  • New Container block: flex/grid layout types, boxed content width, presets, flex-item settings for any child block, positioning, transforms, responsive visibility.
  • Styling system: layout, sizing, position, transform and transition-timing controls; breakpoints filterable with wpbb_style_breakpoints.
  • Initial release: modular core, settings screen, Donix design tokens, Content (14 blocks), Interactive (6 blocks), Marketing (4 blocks), Posts (Posts block with five layouts, Author Box, Dynamic Content) and Media (Gallery, Before / After, Video Gallery) modules.
  • WooCommerce module: Products, Product Categories, Product Search, Add to Cart, Mini Cart, Store Page.
  • Forms & Users module: Login Form (login, registration, lost password, without page reloads), User Profile, Form Styler for Contact Form 7 and WPForms.
  • Advanced module: Advanced Search with live results, Taxonomy Filter.
  • Slider block: slides you design yourself with any blocks, each with its own background image, colour and overlay; slide or fade effect, one or several slides at a time, arrows, dots and autoplay.
  • Settings screen: saves without reloading the page; modules and blocks of the Pro add-on are marked PRO and listed as locked while Pro is not active.
  • Data Visualization module: Chart (bar, horizontal bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, radar; typed, pasted or from a CSV / Google Sheets link), Progress Chart, Statistics Cards.

wpbb/video-gallery.title: Video Gallery
wpbb/video-gallery.description: YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted videos in a grid or carousel. Videos open in a lightbox or play in place, and load only when clicked.

wpbb/stat-cards.name: wpbb/stat-cards
wpbb/stat-cards.title: Statistics Cards
wpbb/stat-cards.description: Key numbers as cards — each with a label, a count-up value, a trend badge and an optional sparkline.

wpbb/chart.name: wpbb/chart
wpbb/chart.title: Chart
wpbb/chart.description: Bar, horizontal bar, line, area, pie, doughnut or radar chart, from your own numbers or a CSV / Google Sheets link. Lightweight SVG, readable by screen readers, no chart library.

wpbb/progress-chart.name: wpbb/progress-chart
wpbb/progress-chart.title: Progress Chart
wpbb/progress-chart.description: One or more progress rings or half-circle gauges with the value in the middle.

wpbb/table-of-contents.name: wpbb/table-of-contents
wpbb/table-of-contents.title: Table of Contents
wpbb/table-of-contents.description: A list of the headings in your post that jumps to each section. Builds and updates itself; highlights the section being read.

wpbb/breadcrumbs.name: wpbb/breadcrumbs
wpbb/breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
wpbb/breadcrumbs.description: Shows where the visitor is: Home › Category › Post. Builds itself for every page, post, archive and search, with breadcrumb structured data for search engines.

wpbb/store-page.name: wpbb/store-page
wpbb/store-page.title: Store Page
wpbb/store-page.description: WooCommerce’s cart, checkout or My Account, placed anywhere in your own page layout.

wpbb/mini-cart.name: wpbb/mini-cart
wpbb/mini-cart.title: Mini Cart
wpbb/mini-cart.description: A cart icon with item count and total that opens a cart drawer or links to the cart — ideal for headers.

wpbb/product-search.name: wpbb/product-search
wpbb/product-search.title: Product Search
wpbb/product-search.description: A WooCommerce product search box, with an optional category dropdown.

wpbb/product-categories.name: wpbb/product-categories
wpbb/product-categories.title: Product Categories
wpbb/product-categories.description: WooCommerce product categories as image tiles in a grid or carousel.

wpbb/add-to-cart.name: wpbb/add-to-cart
wpbb/add-to-cart.title: Add to Cart
wpbb/add-to-cart.description: An add-to-cart button, with quantity and price, for any product or for the product being viewed.

wpbb/products.name: wpbb/products
wpbb/products.title: Products
wpbb/products.description: WooCommerce products in a grid, list, carousel or slider — latest, featured, on sale, best selling, top rated, hand-picked, related, upsells or cross-sells.

wpbb/taxonomy-filter.name: wpbb/taxonomy-filter
wpbb/taxonomy-filter.title: Taxonomy Filter
wpbb/taxonomy-filter.description: Categories, tags or any taxonomy as chips, a list or a dropdown, linking to their archives and highlighting the current one.

wpbb/advanced-search.name: wpbb/advanced-search
wpbb/advanced-search.title: Advanced Search
wpbb/advanced-search.description: A search box with post type and taxonomy filters, and live results as you type.

wpbb/team-member.name: wpbb/team-member
wpbb/team-member.title: Team Member
wpbb/team-member.description: A person's photo, name, role, short bio and social links — stacked, side by side or with the name over the photo.

wpbb/testimonials.name: wpbb/testimonials
wpbb/testimonials.title: Testimonials
wpbb/testimonials.description: What your customers say: quotes with name, role, photo and star rating, in a grid or a carousel.

wpbb/whatsapp-chat.name: wpbb/whatsapp-chat
wpbb/whatsapp-chat.title: WhatsApp Chat
wpbb/whatsapp-chat.description: Lets visitors message you on WhatsApp: a floating chat button with an optional greeting card, or a button in your content. Nothing loads from WhatsApp until it is clicked.

wpbb/social-icons.name: wpbb/social-icons
wpbb/social-icons.title: Social Icons
wpbb/social-icons.description: Links to your social profiles as icons: 28 networks, brand colours or your own style, with optional names.

wpbb/toggle-panel.name: wpbb/toggle-panel
wpbb/toggle-panel.title: Toggle Panel
wpbb/toggle-panel.description: One side of a Content Toggle. Holds any blocks.

wpbb/slide.name: wpbb/slide
wpbb/slide.title: Slide
wpbb/slide.description: One slide of a Slider. Holds any blocks; set its background image, colour and overlay in the Styles tab.

wpbb/timeline-item.name: wpbb/timeline-item
wpbb/timeline-item.title: Timeline Item
wpbb/timeline-item.description: One milestone: date, title and content.

wpbb/process-step.name: wpbb/process-step
wpbb/process-step.title: Process Step
wpbb/process-step.description: One step: marker, title and short description.

wpbb/accordion-item.name: wpbb/accordion-item
wpbb/accordion-item.title: Accordion Item
wpbb/accordion-item.description: One collapsible section of an Accordion. Holds any blocks, including another Accordion.

wpbb/tab.name: wpbb/tab
wpbb/tab.title: Tab
wpbb/tab.description: One panel of a Tabs block. Holds any blocks.
